```{r}
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(SyncRNG)
source("sync_rng_random_functions.r")
USE_SYNCRNG <- TRUE # turns on python and R rng synchronisation
if (USE_SYNCRNG) {
  s <- SyncRNG(seed = 1234)
}
options(digits = 12)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0) Constants (must appear BEFORE params, and contain NO hard-coded overriders)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
map_size      <- 20
time_steps    <- 300
cycles        <- 2
Rth           <- 15
sigma         <- 23
Rpup          <- 87.9
W0            <- 4.1
R0            <- 0.4 * W0
eggs_count    <- 790
pup_delay     <- 37.5
assimilation_eff <- 0.25
E_f <- 30
V_cell <- 5
N_WINNERS <- 4   # used only for interference

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PARAMETERS FROM YAML / LAUNCHER
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
temperature       <- params$temperature
competition       <- params$competition
initial_food_val  <- params$initial_food_val
refill_food_val   <- params$refill_food_val
density_level     <- params$density_level
set.seed(params$seed)

# Density scaling
larval_density_per_cell <- density_level * V_cell

# Food scaled by density
if (competition == "INTERFERENCE") {
    initial_food  <- initial_food_val  * N_WINNERS
    refill_amount <- refill_food_val   * N_WINNERS
} else {
    initial_food  <- initial_food_val  * larval_density_per_cell
    refill_amount <- refill_food_val   * larval_density_per_cell
}

# Carrying capacity (now safe: map_size is defined above)
K_L <- larval_density_per_cell * map_size^2

# Competition modes
USE_EXPLOITATION <- (competition == "EXPLOITATION")
USE_INTERFERENCE <- (competition == "INTERFERENCE")
if (USE_EXPLOITATION == USE_INTERFERENCE) stop("Competition mode error")

# Debug output
cat("\n--- PARAMETERS ---\n")
cat("Temperature:", temperature, "\n")
cat("Competition:", competition, "\n")
cat("Initial food:", initial_food, "(base", initial_food_val, ")\n")
cat("Refill amount:", refill_amount, "(base", refill_food_val, ")\n")
cat("Density level:", density_level, "Actual:", larval_density_per_cell, "\n")
cat("K_L:", K_L, "\n")
cat("Seed:", params$seed, "\n\n")


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) RDG: Discrete temperature-specific parameters and CIs
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
all_temps <- list(

    a = 0.16,

    g = 0.23
  ),

    a = 0.18,

  ),

    a = 0.15,
    c = 0.035,

    beta = 0.58,
    g = 0.40
  ),
  "26" = list(
    a = 0.15,
    c = 0.041,
    alpha = 1.01,
    beta = 0.50,
    g = 0.44
  ),
  "28" = list(
    a = 0.25,
    c = 0.052,
    alpha = 0.81,
    beta = 0.50,
    g = 0.52
  ),

    a = 0.31,

  )

param_CI <- list(

    g = c(0.22, 0.24)
  ),
  "22" = list(
    a = c(0.18, 0.19),
    alpha = c(0.79, 0.83),
    beta = c(0.53, 0.55),
    g = c(0.32, 0.35)
  ),
  "24" = list(
    a = c(0.15, 0.16),
    alpha = c(0.94, 0.98),
    beta = c(0.57, 0.59),
    g = c(0.39, 0.41)
  ),
  "26" = list(
    a = c(0.14, 0.16),

    beta = c(0.50, 0.51),

  ),
  "28" = list(

# Helper: get parameter set for discrete temp
get_params <- function(temp) {
  t_str <- as.character(round(temp))
  if (!(t_str %in% names(all_temps)))
    stop("Temperature not in discrete set (20-30 °C).")
  all_temps[[t_str]]
}

# Helper: random personalisation within CI
get_randomised_params <- function(temp) {
  t_str <- as.character(round(temp))
  base <- all_temps[[t_str]]
  ci   <- param_CI[[t_str]]
  
  # sample uniformly within each CI range
  if (USE_SYNCRNG) {
    personalised <- list(
      a     = sync_rng_uniform(ci$a[1], ci$a[2], as.integer(1), s),
      c     = base$c,
      # no CI given, so keep fixed
      alpha = sync_rng_uniform(ci$alpha[1], ci$alpha[2], as.integer(1), s),
      beta  = sync_rng_uniform(ci$beta[1], ci$beta[2], as.integer(1), s),
      g     = sync_rng_uniform(ci$g[1], ci$g[2], as.integer(1), s)
    )
    personalised
  } else {
  personalised <- list(
    a     = runif(1, ci$a[1], ci$a[2]),
    c     = base$c,
    # no CI given, so keep fixed
    alpha = runif(1, ci$alpha[1], ci$alpha[2]),
    beta  = runif(1, ci$beta[1], ci$beta[2]),
    g     = runif(1, ci$g[1], ci$g[2])
  )
  personalised
  }
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) RDG ODE (inner model; DO NOT CHANGE)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
rdg_model <- function(t, state, pars) {
  W <- state[1]
  R <- state[2]
  
  # Use FA_actual if provided, otherwise compute physiologically
  if (!is.null(pars$FA_actual)) {
    FA <- pars$FA_actual
  } else {
    FA <- pars$g * W * exp(-((R - pars$Rth)^2) / (2 * pars$sigma^2))
  }
  
  M <- pars$c * W^pars$beta
  
  if (FA < M) {
    dW <- 0
    dR <- FA - M
  } else {
    surplus <- FA - M
    dR <- pars$a * surplus^pars$alpha
    dW <- surplus - dR
  }
  
  list(c(dW, dR))
}



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) IBM Helpers: survival, temperature update
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
survival_rates <- function(stage, temperature) {
  if (stage == 1)
    return(ifelse(temperature >= 20 & temperature <= 30, 0.9, 0))
  if (stage == 3)
    return(1.0)
  return(1)
}

update_temperature <- function(temp)
  temp


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Initialisation
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
stage_pop <- matrix(NA,
                    nrow = cycles,
                    ncol = 4,
                    dimnames = list(NULL, c("Eggs", "Larvae", "Pupae", "Adults")))

pupated_all     <- vector("list", cycles)
deceased_all    <- vector("list", cycles)
temperature_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = cycles, ncol = time_steps)
food_matrix        <- matrix(NA, nrow = cycles, ncol = time_steps)
W_matrix           <- matrix(NA, nrow = cycles, ncol = time_steps)
R_matrix           <- matrix(NA, nrow = cycles, ncol = time_steps)

pupation_stats <- data.frame(
  Cycle = integer(),
  PupationTimeMean = numeric(),
  PupationTimeMedian = numeric(),
  PupationMassMean = numeric(),
  PupationMassMedian = numeric(),
  NonPupatedMassMean = numeric(),
  NonPupatedMassMedian = numeric(),
  DeadMassMean = numeric(),
  DeadMassMedian = numeric(),
  EndFoodLevel = numeric()
)

# For survival tracking
prev_larvae_count <- NA

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) Life-Cycle Loop (Optimised)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
lts_size <- cycles * time_steps
lts_Cycle     <- integer(lts_size)
lts_Hour      <- integer(lts_size)
lts_LarvaeCnt <- integer(lts_size)
lts_Survival  <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_Commit    <- integer(lts_size)
lts_Pupated   <- integer(lts_size)
lts_Deaths    <- integer(lts_size)
lts_i <- 1L
lts_ReserveMean   <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_ReserveMedian <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_ReserveMin    <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_ReserveMax    <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_MassMean      <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_MassMedian    <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_MassMin       <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_MassMax       <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_OccupiedCells     <- integer(lts_size)
lts_MeanLarvaePerCell <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_MeanFoodPerCell   <- numeric(lts_size)
lts_FAperCell <- numeric(lts_size)





for (cycle in 1:cycles) {
  cycle_start <- (cycle - 1) * (time_steps + 10) # 10 being a buffer gap between cycles
  grid_food   <- matrix(initial_food, nrow = map_size, ncol = map_size)
  stage_pop[cycle, "Eggs"] <- eggs_count
  larvae_survived <- floor(eggs_count * survival_rates(1, temperature))
  stage_pop[cycle, "Larvae"] <- larvae_survived
  
  # --- Initialise larvae as numeric vectors ---
  if (larvae_survived > 0) {
    W <- rep(W0, larvae_survived)
    R <- rep(R0, larvae_survived)
    if (USE_SYNCRNG) {
      x <- sync_rng_choice(1:map_size, larvae_survived, s, TRUE)
      y <- sync_rng_choice(1:map_size, larvae_survived, s, TRUE)
    } else {
      x <- sample(1:map_size, larvae_survived, TRUE)
      y <- sample(1:map_size, larvae_survived, TRUE)
    }
    pupate_at <- rep(NA_real_, larvae_survived)
    a_fac <- alpha_fac <- beta_fac <- g_fac <- numeric(larvae_survived)
    
    base_par <- get_params(temperature)
    for (i in seq_len(larvae_survived)) {
      p_i <- get_randomised_params(temperature)
      a_fac[i]     <- p_i$a / base_par$a
      alpha_fac[i] <- p_i$alpha / base_par$alpha
      beta_fac[i]  <- p_i$beta / base_par$beta
      g_fac[i]     <- p_i$g / base_par$g
    }
  } else {
    W <- R <- x <- y <- pupate_at <- a_fac <- alpha_fac <- beta_fac <- g_fac <- numeric(0)
  }
  
  pupae_count <- 0L
  temperature_record <- numeric(time_steps)
  pupated_buffer <- list()
  deceased_buffer <- list()
  
  for (hour in 1:time_steps) {
    t_global <- cycle_start + hour
    if (hour %% 24 == 0)
      grid_food <- grid_food + refill_amount
    #temperature <- update_temperature(temperature)
    #temperature <- pmin(pmax(temperature, 20), 30)
    #temperature_record[hour] <- temperature
    food_matrix[cycle, hour] <- sum(grid_food)
    
    # --- Movement ---
    if (length(W) > 0) {
      move_d <- c(-1,0,1)
      if (USE_SYNCRNG) {
        x <- (x + sync_rng_choice(move_d, length(x), s, TRUE) - 1) %% map_size + 1
        y <- (y + sync_rng_choice(move_d, length(y), s, TRUE) - 1) %% map_size + 1
      } else {
        x <- (x + sample(move_d, length(x), TRUE) - 1) %% map_size + 1
        y <- (y + sample(move_d, length(y), TRUE) - 1) %% map_size + 1
      }
    }
    
    p_base <- get_params(temperature)
    current_larvae <- length(W)
    FA_demand <- numeric(current_larvae)
    food_mean_cell <- sum(grid_food) / (map_size^2)
    occupied_cells <- if (current_larvae > 0)
      length(unique((x - 1) * map_size + y))
    else
      0
    mean_larvae_per_cell <- if (occupied_cells > 0)
      current_larvae / occupied_cells
    else
      NA
    # --- Reserve / mass stats ---
    reserve_mean <- reserve_median <- reserve_min <- reserve_max <- NA
    mass_mean <- mass_median <- mass_min <- mass_max <- NA
    if (current_larvae > 0) {
      reserve_mean   <- mean(R)
      reserve_median <- median(R)
      reserve_min    <- min(R)
      reserve_max    <- max(R)
      mass_mean      <- mean(W)
      mass_median    <- median(W)
      mass_min       <- min(W)
      mass_max       <- max(W)
    }
    lts_ReserveMean[lts_i]   <- reserve_mean
    lts_ReserveMedian[lts_i] <- reserve_median
    lts_ReserveMin[lts_i]    <- reserve_min
    lts_ReserveMax[lts_i]    <- reserve_max
    
    lts_MassMean[lts_i]      <- mass_mean
    lts_MassMedian[lts_i]    <- mass_median
    lts_MassMin[lts_i]       <- mass_min
    lts_MassMax[lts_i]       <- mass_max
    
    
    death_count <- 0L
    pupated_now <- 0L
    FA_actual <- numeric(current_larvae)
    lts_OccupiedCells[lts_i]     <- occupied_cells
    lts_MeanLarvaePerCell[lts_i] <- mean_larvae_per_cell
    lts_MeanFoodPerCell[lts_i]   <- food_mean_cell
    
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    #   Resource allocation by cell (integer cell_id)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (current_larvae > 0) {
      cell_id <- (x - 1) * map_size + y
      occupied <- unique(cell_id)
      
      for (cid in occupied) {
        in_cell <- which(cell_id == cid)
        cx <- ((cid - 1) %/% map_size) + 1
        cy <- ((cid - 1) %%  map_size) + 1
        pool <- grid_food[cx, cy]
        
        if (length(in_cell) == 0)
          next
        
        if (USE_EXPLOITATION) {
          g_rate_vec <- p_base$g * g_fac[in_cell]
          FA_desired_vec <- g_rate_vec * W[in_cell] *
            exp(-((R[in_cell] - Rth)^2) / (2 * sigma^2))
          FA_demand[in_cell] <- FA_desired_vec
          eff_vec <- rep(assimilation_eff, length(in_cell))
          eff_vec[eff_vec <= 0 | is.na(eff_vec)] <- 1e-9
          
          req_vec <- FA_desired_vec / eff_vec
          total_req <- sum(req_vec)
          
          if (total_req <= 1e-4 || all(FA_desired_vec <= 0)) {
            next
          }
          
          if (total_req <= pool) {
            FA_actual[in_cell] <- FA_desired_vec
          } else {
            prop <- req_vec / total_req
            pool_share <- pool * prop
            FA_actual[in_cell] <- pmin(pool_share * eff_vec, FA_desired_vec)
          }
          
          grid_food[cx, cy] <- max(0, pool - sum(FA_actual[in_cell] / eff_vec))
        } else if (USE_INTERFERENCE) {
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # INTERFERENCE: minimal, non-invasive fix — keep rules identical
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  if (length(in_cell) > N_WINNERS) {
    # weighted by body mass
    weights <- W[in_cell]
    prob    <- weights / sum(weights)
    if (USE_SYNCRNG) {
      winners_local <- sync_rng_choice(
        in_cell,
        size = N_WINNERS,
        s = s,
        replace = FALSE,
        weights = prob)
    } else {
      winners_local <- sample(
        in_cell,
        size = N_WINNERS,
        prob = prob,
        replace = FALSE)
    }
  } else {
    winners_local <- in_cell
  }
  # ensure losers have zero assimilation this hour
  non_winners <- setdiff(in_cell, winners_local)
  if (length(non_winners) > 0) FA_actual[non_winners] <- 0

  # heavier feed first (preserve original behaviour)
  winners_local <- winners_local[order(W[winners_local], decreasing = TRUE)]

  # use personalised g_fac like in exploitation
  g_rate_vec <- p_base$g * g_fac[winners_local]

  # per-winner desired FA and bookkeeping
  FA_desired_vec <- g_rate_vec * W[winners_local] *
    exp(-((R[winners_local] - Rth)^2) / (2 * sigma^2))

  FA_demand[winners_local] <- FA_desired_vec

  # assimilation vector (consistent numerics)
  eff_vec <- rep(assimilation_eff, length(winners_local))
  eff_vec[eff_vec <= 0 | is.na(eff_vec)] <- 1e-9

  # feeding loop: preserve "all-or-nothing" (no partial feeding) behaviour
  for (k in seq_along(winners_local)) {
    id <- winners_local[k]
    required_from_pool <- FA_desired_vec[k] / eff_vec[k]
    if (pool >= required_from_pool) {
      FA_actual[id] <- FA_desired_vec[k]
      pool <- pool - required_from_pool
    } else {
      break  # preserve original behaviour: do not partially feed the next winner
    }
  }

  # --- CRITICAL: write updated pool back into the grid (fix) ---
  grid_food[cx, cy] <- max(0, pool)
}

        
      } # end for each occupied cell
    }
    
        if (current_larvae > 0) {
      total_FA <- sum(FA_demand)
      lts_FAperCell[lts_i] <- total_FA / (map_size^2)
    } else {
      lts_FAperCell[lts_i] <- 0
    }
    
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    #   Growth / reserve update (vectorised where possible)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if (current_larvae > 0) {
      to_die <- logical(current_larvae)
      for (i in seq_len(current_larvae)) {
        pars <- list(
          a = p_base$a * a_fac[i],
          c = p_base$c,
          alpha = p_base$alpha * alpha_fac[i],
          beta = p_base$beta  * beta_fac[i],
          g = p_base$g * g_fac[i],
          FA_actual = FA_actual[i]
        )
        state <- c(W[i], R[i])
        k1 <- rdg_model(0, state, pars)[[1]]
        k2 <- rdg_model(0, state + 0.5 * k1, pars)[[1]]
        k3 <- rdg_model(0, state + 0.5 * k2, pars)[[1]]
        k4 <- rdg_model(0, state + k3, pars)[[1]]
        delta <- (k1 + 2 * k2 + 2 * k3 + k4) / 6
        W[i] <- W[i] + delta[1]
        R[i] <- R[i] + delta[2]
        if (R[i] < 0)
          to_die[i] <- TRUE
        if (is.na(pupate_at[i]) && R[i] >= Rpup)
          pupate_at[i] <- t_global + pup_delay
      }
      
      
      # --- Batch removals ---
      if (any(to_die)) {
        deceased_buffer[[length(deceased_buffer) + 1]] <-
          data.frame(
            W = W[to_die],
            R = R[to_die],
            x = x[to_die],
            y = y[to_die]
          )
        death_count <- sum(to_die)
        keep <- !to_die
        W <- W[keep]
        R <- R[keep]
        x <- x[keep]
        y <- y[keep]
        a_fac <- a_fac[keep]
        alpha_fac <- alpha_fac[keep]
        beta_fac <- beta_fac[keep]
        g_fac <- g_fac[keep]
        pupate_at <- pupate_at[keep]
        FA_actual <- FA_actual[keep]
      }
      
      to_pup <- which(!is.na(pupate_at) & pupate_at <= t_global)
      if (length(to_pup) > 0) {
        pupated_buffer[[length(pupated_buffer) + 1]] <-
          data.frame(
            W = W[to_pup],
            R = R[to_pup],
            x = x[to_pup],
            y = y[to_pup]
          )
        pupated_now <- length(to_pup)
        pupae_count <- pupae_count + pupated_now
        keep <- !(seq_along(W) %in% to_pup)
        W <- W[keep]
        R <- R[keep]
        x <- x[keep]
        y <- y[keep]
        a_fac <- a_fac[keep]
        alpha_fac <- alpha_fac[keep]
        beta_fac <- beta_fac[keep]
        g_fac <- g_fac[keep]
        pupate_at <- pupate_at[keep]
        FA_actual <- FA_actual[keep]
      }
    }
    
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    #   Record statistics (preallocated vectors)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
    W_matrix[cycle, hour] <- ifelse(length(W) > 0, mean(W), NA)
    R_matrix[cycle, hour] <- ifelse(length(R) > 0, mean(R), NA)
    survival_rate <- if (!is.na(prev_larvae_count) &&
                         prev_larvae_count > 0)
      current_larvae / prev_larvae_count
    else
      NA
    prev_larvae_count <- current_larvae
    
    lts_Cycle[lts_i]     <- cycle
    lts_Hour[lts_i]      <- hour
    lts_LarvaeCnt[lts_i] <- current_larvae
    lts_Survival[lts_i]  <- survival_rate
    lts_Commit[lts_i]    <- sum(!is.na(pupate_at) &
                                  pupate_at == t_global + pup_delay)
    lts_Pupated[lts_i]   <- pupated_now
    lts_Deaths[lts_i]    <- death_count
    lts_i <- lts_i + 1L
  } # end hour loop
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  #   Aggregate per cycle
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  pupated_all[[cycle]] <- if (length(pupated_buffer) > 0)
    do.call(rbind, pupated_buffer)
  else
    data.frame()
  deceased_all[[cycle]] <- if (length(deceased_buffer) > 0)
    do.call(rbind, deceased_buffer)
  else
    data.frame()
  
  stage_pop[cycle, "Pupae"] <- pupae_count
  adults_count <- floor(pupae_count * survival_rates(3, temperature))
  stage_pop[cycle, "Adults"] <- adults_count
  
  # --- Adult / egg feedback ---
  if (adults_count <= 0) {
    eggs_count <- 0
  } else {
    females_count <- floor(adults_count / 2)
    if (females_count <= 0) {
      eggs_count <- 0
    } else {
      prob <- min(1, K_L / (females_count * E_f))
      if (USE_SYNCRNG) {
        retained_females <- sync_rng_binomial(females_count, prob, s)
      } else {
        retained_females <- rbinom(1, females_count, prob)
      }
      if (retained_females == 0 &&
          females_count > 0)
        retained_females <- 1
      eggs_count <- retained_females * E_f
    }
  }
  
  temperature_matrix[cycle, ] <- temperature_record
  
  pupated     <- pupated_all[[cycle]]
  non_pupated <- if (length(W) > 0)
    data.frame(W, R, x, y)
  else
    data.frame()
  deceased    <- deceased_all[[cycle]]
  
  pupation_times_cycle <- if (nrow(pupated) > 0)
    pupated$pupate_at - cycle_start
  else
    numeric()
  
  pupation_stats <- rbind(
    pupation_stats,
    data.frame(
      Cycle = cycle,
      PupationTimeMean   = ifelse(
        length(pupation_times_cycle) > 0,
        mean(pupation_times_cycle),
        NA
      ),
      PupationTimeMedian = ifelse(
        length(pupation_times_cycle) > 0,
        median(pupation_times_cycle),
        NA
      ),
      PupationMassMean   = ifelse(nrow(pupated) > 0, mean(pupated$W), NA),
      PupationMassMedian = ifelse(nrow(pupated) > 0, median(pupated$W), NA),
      NonPupatedMassMean = ifelse(nrow(non_pupated) > 0, mean(non_pupated$W), NA),
      NonPupatedMassMedian = ifelse(nrow(non_pupated) > 0, median(non_pupated$W), NA),
      DeadMassMean       = ifelse(nrow(deceased) > 0, mean(deceased$W), NA),
      DeadMassMedian     = ifelse(nrow(deceased) > 0, median(deceased$W), NA),
      EndFoodLevel       = sum(grid_food) / (map_size^2)
    )
  )
} # end cycle loop

# ---- Assemble time series once ----
larval_time_series <- data.frame(
  Cycle = lts_Cycle[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  Hour = lts_Hour[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  LarvaeCount = lts_LarvaeCnt[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  SurvivalRate = lts_Survival[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  PupationCommitments = lts_Commit[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  Pupated = lts_Pupated[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  Deaths = lts_Deaths[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  ReserveMean = lts_ReserveMean[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  ReserveMedian = lts_ReserveMedian[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  ReserveMin = lts_ReserveMin[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  ReserveMax = lts_ReserveMax[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  MassMean = lts_MassMean[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  MassMedian = lts_MassMedian[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  MassMin = lts_MassMin[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  MassMax = lts_MassMax[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  OccupiedCells = lts_OccupiedCells[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  MeanLarvaePerCell = lts_MeanLarvaePerCell[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  MeanFoodPerCell = lts_MeanFoodPerCell[1:(lts_i - 1)],
  FAperCell = lts_FAperCell[1:(lts_i - 1)]
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ---- Set Target Cycle for Single Plots ----
target_cycle <- 9  # Change as needed

# ---- 1. Plot Each Metric for the Selected Cycle ----
plot_single_cycle_metric <- function(df, metric, cycle_num) {
  df_cycle <- df %>%
    filter(Cycle == cycle_num) %>%
    select(Hour, !!sym(metric)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  ggplot(df_cycle, aes(x = Hour, y = !!sym(metric))) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = paste(metric, "- Cycle", cycle_num),
      x = "Hour",
      y = metric
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

single_cycle_plots <- map(metric_columns,
                          ~ plot_single_cycle_metric(larval_data, .x, target_cycle))

plot_combined_metrics <- function(df, metrics, cycle_num) {
  df_cycle <- df %>%
    filter(Cycle == cycle_num) %>%
    select(Hour, all_of(metrics)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # ---- Convert selected event metrics to cumulative sums ----
  cumulative_metrics <- c("PupationCommitments", "Pupated", "Deaths")
  for (m in cumulative_metrics) {
    if (m %in% names(df_cycle)) {
      df_cycle[[m]] <- cumsum(df_cycle[[m]])
    }
  }
  
  df_long <- df_cycle %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(metrics),
                 names_to = "Metric",
                 values_to = "Value")
  
  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Hour, y = Value, color = Metric)) +
    geom_line(size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Combined Metrics - Cycle", cycle_num),
      x = "Hour",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}


reserve_combined <- plot_combined_metrics(
  larval_data,
  c("ReserveMean", "ReserveMedian", "ReserveMin", "ReserveMax"),
  target_cycle
)
print(reserve_combined)

fa_vs_food_percell_plot <- function(df, cycle_num) {
  df_cycle <- df %>%
    filter(Cycle == cycle_num) %>%
    select(Hour, FAperCell, MeanFoodPerCell)
  
  df_long <- df_cycle %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c("FAperCell", "MeanFoodPerCell"),
      names_to = "Metric",
      values_to = "Value"
    )
  
  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Hour, y = Value, color = Metric)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = paste("FA Demand vs Food (per cell) — Cycle", cycle_num),
      x = "Hour",
      y = "Value per cell"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}

# ---- 2. Plot Each Metric for All Cycles in Facets ----
plot_all_cycles_metric <- function(df, metric) {
  df_all <- df %>%
    select(Cycle, Hour, !!sym(metric)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  p <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = Hour, y = !!sym(metric))) +
    geom_line(color = "darkgreen", size = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ Cycle, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(title = paste(metric, "- All Cycles"),
         x = "Hour",
         y = metric) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # --- Cap y-axis for survival rate between 0 and 1 ---
  if (metric == "SurvivalRate") {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1))
  }
  
  p
}


# ---- Detect first all-zero cycle based on LarvaeCount ----
zero_cycles <- larval_data %>%
  group_by(Cycle) %>%
  summarise(all_zero = all(LarvaeCount == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(all_zero) %>%
  pull(Cycle)

if (length(zero_cycles) > 0) {
  cutoff_cycle <- min(zero_cycles)
  message("Truncating plots after extinction at cycle ", cutoff_cycle)
  larval_data_plot <- larval_data %>% filter(Cycle < cutoff_cycle)
} else {
  larval_data_plot <- larval_data
}

# -- 1. Prepare stage data safely --------------------------------
